tl.soilTipAria: Help: how much water is in the soil where roots grow: 0 = completely dry, 1 = full of water.
tl.trendTip: Trend = the direction over 20 years, from a straight line through the yearly values.
tl.trendClear: Clear trend: the change is bigger than normal year-to-year ups and downs.
tl.trendWeak: Weak trend: the change could be normal year-to-year variation.
tl.powerErr: NASA POWER could not be reached and no saved copy exists for this area.

wx.title: Weather now
wx.error: The weather service could not be reached.
risk.title: Risks for this field
risk.noData: No data right now: the NASA service could not be reached.
risk.drought.name: Drought risk
risk.drought.tip: Chance that the field gets too little water, from 20 years of rain and soil-moisture data.
risk.drought.advice.low: Enough rain and soil water now. Normal watering is fine.
risk.drought.advice.medium: Drier than usual. Water a bit more often and keep the soil covered.
risk.drought.advice.high: Very dry. Choose crops that need little water and plan irrigation.
risk.heat.name: Heat risk
risk.heat.tip: Chance that plants are stressed by heat, from recent hot months and the temperature now.
risk.heat.advice.low: Temperatures are normal for this place.
risk.heat.advice.medium: Hotter than usual. Water early in the morning and avoid work at midday.
risk.heat.advice.high: Very hot. Shade young plants, water morning or evening, protect workers.
risk.fire.name: Fire risk
risk.fire.tip: Chance of fire near the field, from fires seen by satellites in the last 10 days plus dry, hot weather.
risk.fire.advice.low: No fires close to this field.
risk.fire.advice.medium: Fires were seen in the area. Clear dry grass around the field.
risk.fire.advice.high: Fires are close. Remove dry plants, keep water ready, watch for smoke.
risk.droughtWhy: Rainfall trend over 20 years is {trend}; in {year} ({span}) root soil moisture is {soil} against a norm of {soilNorm} ({soilPct}%) and rainfall is {rain} mm against {rainNorm} mm ({rainPct}%).
risk.heatWhy: {hot} of the last {checked} months had maximum temperatures at least {margin} °C above the 20-year normal
risk.fireSome.one: NASA FIRMS shows {n} fire detection within {r} km in the last {days} days ({near} within {nearKm} km, nearest {nearest} km away)
risk.fireSome.other: NASA FIRMS shows {n} fire detections within {r} km in the last {days} days ({near} within {nearKm} km, nearest {nearest} km away)
risk.fireNone: NASA FIRMS shows no fire detections within {r} km in the last {days} days
risk.fireSoil: root soil moisture is {pct}% against the 20-year norm
adv.title: Crop advisor
adv.note: Advisory tool, confirm with a local agronomist.
adv.waitTerrain: Waiting for the terrain analysis (elevation and slope)…
adv.noClimate: NASA climate data is unavailable right now, so crops cannot be scored.
adv.best3Tip: Score from 0 to 100: how well each crop fits this field’s temperature, water, soil moisture, height and slope. Highest first.
adv.staysDecades: Stays for decades: not part of a yearly rotation.
adv.staysYears: Stays about {years} years: not part of a yearly rotation.
adv.fertPart: The legume year gives back part of what the other crops take; add manure or compost before the heaviest feeder.
adv.fertFull: The legume year puts back at least as much nitrogen as the other crops take.
adv.fertNone: No legume scored well enough here: add manure or compost every year to keep the soil fertile.
adv.goodMatch: Good match for the weather, water and land of this field.
adv.limit.temp: the temperature is outside its best range
adv.limit.hot: summers are too hot for it
adv.limit.short: it needs more water than you have
adv.limit.wet: there is too much rain for it
adv.limit.soil: the soil is too dry or too wet for it
adv.limit.elev: the field is too high or too low for it
adv.limit.slope: the field is too steep for it
adv.limit.drought: it is risky in a drought without irrigation
adv.tooCool: Too cool here: the normal temperature never reaches the {t} °C it needs by July.
adv.tooWarm: Autumn stays above {t} °C here: too warm for autumn sowing.
adv.window: {what} {from} – {to}: normal temperature is {t1}–{t2} °C then, with about {rain} mm of rain in {month}.
adv.dryIrr: Little rain then: irrigate at planting.
adv.dryNoIrr: Little rain then: needs watering to establish.
adv.r.hot: Hottest month reaches {t} °C, above its {max} °C limit.
adv.r.short: {water}: short of the {a}–{b} mm it needs.
adv.r.wet: Rain {rain} mm/yr is more than its {b} mm upper limit.
adv.r.soil: Root soil moisture in season is {v}{irr}; it likes {a}–{b}.
adv.r.elev: Field elevation {v} m; it grows at {a}–{b} m.
adv.r.drought: Drought risk is {level} and the field is not irrigated: risky for a crop with {need} water need.
adv.rot.first: Best-scoring annual crop for this field ({score}/100).
adv.rot.legume: Legume after {prev}: puts back the nitrogen the {family} used.
adv.rot.feeder: Uses the nitrogen left by {prev}; a different family breaks pest and disease cycles.
adv.rot.change: Different family from {prev} ({from} → {to}): breaks pest and disease cycles.
adv.w.verySteep: Very steep: mean slope {v}°. High erosion risk; avoid ploughed row crops. Terraces or permanent cover ({crops}) hold the soil.
adv.w.steep: Steep: mean slope {v}°. Erosion risk; plough and plant along the contour and keep the soil covered. Best slope holders: {crops}.
adv.w.droughtHigh: Drought risk is HIGH for this field. Without irrigation, prefer low-water crops: {crops}.
adv.w.droughtHighIrr: Drought risk is HIGH for this field. Plan irrigation carefully and prefer low-water crops: {crops}.
adv.w.droughtMed: Drought risk is medium and the field is not irrigated: low-water crops ({crops}) are the safer choice.
adv.wt.irrTip: Water you must add yourself: water needed minus water from rain. 1 mm on 1 hectare = 10 m³.
adv.wt.field: {v} m³ per year for this field
adv.wt.looking: looking for the nearest river, canal or lake…
crop.wheat.name: Winter wheat
crop.wheat.note: Cereal: uses nitrogen, leaves straw that protects the soil.
crop.barley.name: Barley
crop.barley.note: Hardy cereal for dry and high land; light nitrogen user.
crop.maize.name: Maize
crop.maize.note: Heavy feeder: takes a lot of nitrogen, best after a legume.
crop.potato.name: Potato
crop.potato.note: Loosens the soil; do not follow with tomato (same family, shared diseases).
crop.onion.name: Onion
crop.onion.note: Shallow roots; a good break crop between cereals and vegetables.
crop.tomato.name: Tomato
crop.tomato.note: Heavy feeder; needs steady water and a different family the year before.
crop.chickpea.name: Chickpea
crop.chickpea.note: Legume: adds nitrogen for the next crop and needs little water.
crop.lentil.name: Lentil
crop.lentil.note: Legume: adds nitrogen; suits cooler, drier uplands.
crop.alfalfa.name: Alfalfa
crop.alfalfa.note: Perennial legume: builds nitrogen over 3-5 years and its deep roots hold the soil.
crop.cotton.name: Cotton
crop.cotton.note: Heavy feeder and water user; rotate with alfalfa or a grain legume.
crop.apricot.name: Apricot orchard
crop.apricot.note: Permanent orchard: tree roots hold slopes; grow a legume between the rows in the first years.
